fusions.name: Beady Stare
fusions.desc: A stare from hiding strikes the first enemy within 8 tiles for 7 damage and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds. It has 40% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: The Picked Moment
fusions.desc: Strikes one enemy from hiding, up to 7 tiles away: it deals 24 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. The hit is always a critical hit and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Saw It Coming
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and you move 15% faster for the first 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Watcher in the Wall
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your critical chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
